title: A continuous-wave fNIRS pipeline with synthetic data
text: governed continuous-wave object needs intensity assay, time_seconds column, SNIRF measurement list, probe. recording two source-detector pairs – one long (3 cm) one short (0.8 cm) – sampled 760 nm 850 nm 16 s 10 Hz, shared cardiac pulsation, slow task response, one motion spike. probe geometry yields source-detector distance measurement:
code: fs <- 10 n_time <- 160L t <- seq_len(n_time) / fs cardiac <- 0.06 * sin(2 * pi * 1.0 * t) task <- 0.08 * exp(-((t - 8)^2) / (2 * 2^2)) base_od <- c(1.2, 1.0, 1.1, 0.9) wl_gain <- c(1.0, 0.8, 1.0, 0.8) od_true <- sapply(1:4, function(j) base_od[j] + cardiac + wl_gain[j] * task) od_true[round(n_time / 2), ] <- od_true[round(n_time / 2), ] + 0.7   # motion intensity <- sweep(exp(-od_true), 2L, c(5000, 4000, 5200, 4100), "*") channel_label <- c("S1_D1_760", "S1_D1_850", "S2_D2_760", "S2_D2_850") colnames(intensity) <- channel_label  measurement <- S4Vectors::DataFrame(   measurement_index = 1:4,   source_index = c(1L, 1L, 2L, 2L), detector_index = c(1L, 1L, 2L, 2L),   wavelength_index = c(1L, 2L, 1L, 2L), wavelength_nm = c(760, 850, 760, 850),   wavelength_actual_nm = NA_real_, data_type = 1L, data_type_index = 1L,   data_type_label = NA_character_, data_unit = NA_character_,   source_power = NA_real_, detector_gain = NA_real_,   source_label = c("S1", "S1", "S2", "S2"),   detector_label = c("D1", "D1", "D2", "D2"), channel_label = channel_label)  probe <- list(   wavelengths = c(760, 850), sourceLabels = c("S1", "S2"),   detectorLabels = c("D1", "D2"),   sourcePos2D = rbind(c(0, 0), c(0.1, 0)),   detectorPos2D = rbind(c(0, 0.03), c(0.1, 0.008)), LengthUnit = "m")  pe <- PhysioExperiment::PhysioExperiment(   assays = list(raw = intensity),   rowData = S4Vectors::DataFrame(time_seconds = t),   colData = cbind(measurement, label = channel_label),   metadata = list(snirf = list(measurement_list = measurement, probe = probe,                                stim = list(), time_sampling = "uniform")),   samplingRate = fs) pe <- PhysioExperiment::setEvents(pe, PhysioExperiment::PhysioEvents(   onset = 6, duration = 4, type = "task", value = "task")) dim(pe) #> [1] 160   4 sourceDetectorDistances(pe) #> DataFrame with 4 rows and 9 columns #>   measurement_index source_index detector_index wavelength_index wavelength_nm #>           <integer>    <integer>      <integer>        <integer>     <numeric> #> 1                 1            1              1                1           760 #> 2                 2            1              1                2           850 #> 3                 3            2              2                1           760 #> 4                 4            2              2                2           850 #>   channel_label  distance distance_unit geometry_dimension #>     <character> <numeric>   <character>        <character> #> 1     S1_D1_760     0.030             m                 2d #> 2     S1_D1_850     0.030             m                 2d #> 3     S2_D2_760     0.008             m                 2d #> 4     S2_D2_850     0.008             m                 2d

title: A continuous-wave fNIRS pipeline with synthetic data

code: sqi <- signalQualityIndex(od) sqi #> NIRS quality <phoebe_peak_power>: 4 channels x 1 windows; pass 4/4 pruned <- pruneChannels(od, sqi, action = "mark") dim(pruned) #> [1] 160   4

title: A continuous-wave fNIRS pipeline with synthetic data
text: Short channels mostly see scalp haemodynamics. Identify distance, regress signal long channels systemic-physiology nuisance.
code: short <- identifyShortChannels(od, threshold_m = 0.015) short[, c("channel_id", "distance_m", "is_short")] #>    channel_id distance_m is_short #> 1 S1_D1_wl760      0.030    FALSE #> 2 S1_D1_wl850      0.030    FALSE #> 3 S2_D2_wl760      0.008     TRUE #> 4 S2_D2_wl850      0.008     TRUE od_ssr <- shortSeparationRegress(od, short = short) SummarizedExperiment::assayNames(od_ssr) #> [1] "raw"    "OD"     "OD_ssr"

title: A continuous-wave fNIRS pipeline with synthetic data
text: Finally, fit general linear model HbO concentration HRF regressor built object’s stimulus events, read per-channel task contrast.
code: fit <- nirsActivationGLM(hb, assay_name = "HbO") fit$coefficients #>   channel condition       beta        se         t  df        p #> 1   S1_D1      task 0.02519858 0.1536975 0.1639491 152 0.869989 #> 2   S2_D2      task 0.09449466 0.5763657 0.1639491 152 0.869989 nirsActivationContrast(fit, c(task = 1)) #>   channel   estimate        se         t  df        p #> 1   S1_D1 0.02519858 0.1536975 0.1639491 152 0.869989 #> 2   S2_D2 0.09449466 0.5763657 0.1639491 152 0.869989

what: Governed Near-Infrared Spectroscopy Data and SNIRF Input/Output
title: Governed Near-Infrared Spectroscopy Data and SNIRF Input/Output
text: PhysioNIRS provides governed SNIRF input/output, optical-density, haemoglobin, motion-correction, short-separation contracts near-infrared spectroscopy data represented PhysioExperiment objects. governed optical-density assay, short-separation processing explicit: Short-channel regression signal-processing choice, evidence channel contains extracerebral physiology. Named physiology bands nuisance ranges rather diagnoses, population-appropriate explicit ranges used adult defaults unsuitable. SNIRF metadata can contain subject identifiers acquisition dates. Remove replace identifying metadata sharing files.
code: library(PhysioNIRS)  # A continuous-wave SNIRF file bundled with the package (no download needed). snirf <- system.file(   "extdata", "snirf_official_simple_probe.snirf", package = "PhysioNIRS" ) x <- readSNIRF(snirf) measurementList(x) sourceDetectorDistances(x, unit = "m")  x_od <- intensityToOD(x, assay_name = "raw")   # raw intensity -> optical density x_hb <- mbll(x_od, assay_name = "OD")          # optical density -> haemoglobin  writeSNIRF(x, file.path(tempdir(), "roundtrip.snirf")) short <- identifyShortChannels(x_od, threshold_m = 0.01)  # When the probe includes short channels, regress them out and build a # physiology nuisance design. (This symmetric example probe has only # standard-separation channels, so the step below is skipped here.) if (any(short$is_short) && !all(short$is_short)) {   corrected <- shortSeparationRegress(     x_od, assay_name = "OD", short = short   )   nuisance <- shortSeparationDesign(     x_od,     assay_name = "OD",     short = short,     aggregation = "mean",     physiology_bands = c("mayer", "respiration")   ) }

text: Fits general linear model every haemoglobin channel HRF-convolved task regressors: condition, boxcar stimulus blocks convolved canonical double-gamma HRF, plus discrete-cosine drift basis optional short-separation nuisance regressors. Returns per-channel activation amplitude (beta), standard error t-statistic condition. Run separately HbO HbR assays.

title: First-level fNIRS cortical-activation GLM — nirsActivationGLM
text: x PhysioExperiment haemoglobin concentration (e.g. HbO assay mbll()). events data.frame numeric onset duration (seconds) condition column; NULL, object's events (PhysioExperiment::getEvents onset/duration/value) used, value condition. assay_name Assay model (default "HbO"). conditions Optional character vector selecting/ordering conditions. basis "canonical" (HRF ) "derivative" (HRF + temporal derivative per condition). drift Number discrete-cosine drift terms (default 6). nuisance Optional numeric matrix extra nuisance regressors (e.g. shortSeparationDesign() output). hrf List HRF parameters (peak, undershoot, ratio). prewhiten "none" "ar1" (per-channel AR(1) prewhitening; strongly recommended fNIRS avoid inflated t-statistics).

title: PhysioNIRS 0.6.0
text: First-level cortical-activation GLM. nirsActivationGLM(): fits every haemoglobin channel HRF-convolved task regressors (per-condition boxcars stimulus blocks convolved canonical double-gamma HRF), discrete-cosine drift basis, optional short-separation nuisance regressors, returning per-channel/per-condition activation beta, SE t. Supports temporal-derivative basis per-channel AR(1) prewhitening (fNIRS residuals strongly autocorrelated, naive OLS t-statistics inflated). nirsActivationContrast(): linear contrasts condition betas (estimate, SE, t, p per channel).

title: PhysioNIRS 0.5.1
text: Fixed pruneChannels() / quality-contract validation R >= 4.4.0: R 4.4 changed .atomic(NULL) TRUE FALSE, .nirs_quality_plain() wrongly rejected governed quality results carrying NULL optional-parameter sentinels (e.g. step_seconds = NULL) ‘stale malformed’. NULL now handled explicitly plain leaf (pre-4.4 behaviour). Made MBLL reference-fixture self-consistency check portable: stored intensity recomputed optical density via exp() (transcendental whose last bit toolchain-dependent), exact (tolerance = 0) compare now tolerance = 1e-12 (~2300x measured cross-platform noise). File-hash governance unaffected.
